sections.name: File setup, PUBLIC_PATHS
sections.title: Imports and public address list
sections.what: Brings in the request tools and the session check. Lists the addresses anyone can visit without logging in.
sections.why: Likely reason: sign-in, sign-up and onboarding must work before a user has a session.
sections.watch_out: Adding a private page to this list by mistake makes it public.

sections.name: middleware
sections.title: Login gate for each request
sections.what: Decides for each request whether it may pass. Public paths and static files pass. Everything else needs a valid session cookie, or the visitor is sent to login.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps every private page and API behind one check.
sections.watch_out: Prefix matching means a short public entry opens similar addresses too, so keep entries specific.

sections.why: Likely reason: limits the check to requests that need it, for speed.

summary: Checks each request before it reaches a page or API and sends visitors without a valid login to the login page.
purpose: Protects private pages and APIs so only logged-in users reach them.
why: Likely reason: one central check is easier to keep correct than a separate check on every page.
how: 1. Lets through public pages: login, register, onboard, admin setup and a few auth routes. 2. Lets through static files and the health check. 3. Looks for the session cookie. 4. If it is missing, redirects to login. 5. Checks the cookie's signature with `verifySession`. 6. If the check fails, clears the cookie and redirects to login. 7. Otherwise lets the request continue.
inputs: Each request's address and its session cookie.
outputs: Either the request continues, or the browser is redirected to login, with a bad cookie cleared.
risks: Public paths match by prefix, so any address starting with one of them is also public. That includes `/api/admin/setup`, which must protect itself. Admin rights are not checked here, so admin APIs must check on their own. The signature check runs on every request, so a slow session check slows everything.
debug: If users loop back to login, check the session cookie and `verifySession` in lib/session. If a public page redirects, check its address against PUBLIC_PATHS. If an API returns a login page instead of data, check the matcher setting.
